# copy

Copy data from source to target Dataverse environment

## Usage

```
ppds data copy [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--batch-size` |  | `int` |  | Records per API request (all records are exported; this controls request size) |
| `--bypass-flows` |  | `bool` |  | Bypass Power Automate flow triggers on target (no special privilege required) |
| `--bypass-plugins` |  | `string` |  | Bypass custom plugin execution on target: sync, async, or all (requires prvBypassCustomBusinessLogic privilege) |
| `--continue-on-error` |  | `bool` |  | Continue import on individual record failures |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Enable diagnostic logging output |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--parallel` |  | `int` |  | Maximum concurrent entity exports (only applies when schema contains multiple entities) |
| `--schema` | `-s` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to schema.xml file |
| `--skip-missing-columns` |  | `bool` |  | Skip columns that exist in source but not in target environment (prevents schema mismatch errors) |
| `--source-env` | `-se` | `string` |  | Source environment - accepts URL, friendly name, unique name, or ID |
| `--source-profile` | `-sp` | `string` |  | Authentication profile for source environment (defaults to active profile) |
| `--strip-owner-fields` |  | `bool` |  | Strip ownership fields (ownerid, createdby, modifiedby) allowing Dataverse to assign current user |
| `--target-env` | `-te` | `string` |  | Target environment - accepts URL, friendly name, unique name, or ID |
| `--target-profile` | `-tp` | `string` |  | Authentication profile(s) for target environment - comma-separated for parallel imports (defaults to active profile) |
| `--temp-dir` |  | `DirectoryInfo` |  | Temporary directory for intermediate data file (default: system temp) |
| `--user-mapping` | `-u` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to user mapping XML file for remapping user references |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Enable verbose logging output |
